DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お申し込みのお名前についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the name on your application?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。書類の名前は長いので、行事では短い呼び名で呼んでほしいです。どこに書けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 市行事で長名と別の短い呼称希望の記入先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My name on the documents is long, so I would like to be called by a shorter name at the event. Where should I write that?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where to enter your preferred short form of address, different from your long name, for a city event. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 必要な申込情報と、当日の呼び方の希望を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check the required application information and how you would like to be addressed that day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。短い名前を本名の代わりに書いて、申込者が分からなくなるのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本名欄を呼称で置換し申込者不明にしたくないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. I want to avoid writing the short name instead of my real name and making it impossible to identify the applicant.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you do not want to replace the real-name field with your preferred name and leave the applicant unidentified. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 書類の記入方法は、担当からご案内します。呼び名は読み方もお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will explain how to fill out the documents. Please also tell us how to pronounce your preferred name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。この短い呼び名です。長い名前を変える手続きではなく、行事で呼ばれる時の希望です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 呼称読みを示し氏名変更手続きではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. This is the short name. I am not applying to change my long name; this is just how I would like to be addressed at the event.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show how to pronounce your preferred name and explain that this is not a legal name-change procedure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのご希望として担当へお伝えします。当日の名札についても気になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will pass that preference on to the person in charge. Are you also concerned about the name badge for the day?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 気になります。名札の表記も相談できますか。参加者全員へ、書類の名前を見せる必要があるか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 名札表記と参加者への氏名表示範囲を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Can I also discuss what appears on the badge? I do not know whether I need to show my name from the documents to all the participants.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Discuss the name on the badge and who among the participants needs to see your full name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 名札の扱いも行事の担当に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us also check with the event organizer about the name badges.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。申込に必要な名前は案内どおり書き、呼び名と名札の希望は別に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 必須申込名と呼称名札希望を別々に記入伝達すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will write the name required for the application as instructed and separately state my preferences for how I am addressed and for my badge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will enter and communicate the required application name separately from your preferences for your form of address and badge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、記入方法と当日の案内を確認します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check the instructions for completing the form and for the day of the event. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票の状態について、お困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the condition of your medical questionnaire?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 暑くて手が汗でぬれ、字がにじみました。読みにくい所を、書き直した方がよいか見てほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 汗で問診字がにじみ再記入要否を確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My hands got sweaty in the heat and the writing smudged. Could you look at the hard-to-read parts and tell me whether I should write them again?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that sweat smudged the writing on your medical questionnaire and that you want to check whether it needs rewriting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらで確認します。内容も変更するご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check it here. Do you also wish to change the contents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、内容は同じです。症状を書いたこの行が特に読めなくなっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 内容変更希望なしで症状行の判読問題を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, the contents are the same. This line about my symptoms has become particularly hard to read.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out that you do not want to change the contents and that the line about symptoms is illegible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要なら新しい用紙をご案内します。元の用紙もお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can provide a new form if necessary. Please keep the original form with you as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。書き直す時に、にじんだ字を想像して写すのでなく、自分が伝えたかった症状をもう一度書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 元紙保持し不明文字推測転写でなく伝えたい内容を再記入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. When rewriting it, I will describe the symptoms I wanted to communicate again, rather than guess at the smudged letters and copy them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Keep the original sheet and rewrite what you intended to communicate rather than guessing and copying illegible letters. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 気づいた書き間違いがある場合も、担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you notice any mistakes in what you wrote, please tell the person in charge about those too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。字がにじんだことと、内容を訂正することは分けて話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 判読性と内容訂正を別に説明すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will explain the smudged writing and any corrections to the contents separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will explain legibility issues separately from corrections to the contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記入した後は、担当が受け取る前に、ご自身でも見直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: After filling it out, please check it yourself before the staff member receives it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうします。古い方は黙って捨てず、二枚になった理由を伝えてから受付へ渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 再記入後自己点検し旧紙と二枚理由を受付へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. I will not quietly throw away the old one. I will explain why there are two sheets before handing them to reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the rewritten form yourself, then tell reception about the old sheet and why there are two copies. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、用紙を確認します。こちらでお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check the form. Please wait here. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 講話の準備についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss preparations for the talk, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。地区で交通の話を聞く予定です。参加者から質問を集めたのですが、個人の事故の話も混ざっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 地区交通講話用の収集質問に個別事故が混じると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. We are planning to attend a traffic safety talk in our district. I collected questions from the participants, but some concern individual accidents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that questions collected for a district traffic talk include individual accident cases. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一般的な質問と、個別の事情を確認する相談は分けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us separate general questions from consultations that require checking individual circumstances.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。みんなの前で、事故を起こした人の名前や詳しい状況を読み上げない方がよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 全体会で氏名と個別事情を読上げないと理解を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. We should avoid reading out the names of the people involved in accidents or the detailed circumstances in front of everyone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that you understand not to read out names or personal circumstances at the group session. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 個別の相談は、ご本人の希望と相談先を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: For individual consultations, please check what the person concerned wants and whom they should consult.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。その人に確認して、講話の質問には通学や自転車についての一般的な内容を残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人希望確認し一般通学自転車質問のみ一覧に残すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will check with that person and keep the general questions about traveling to school and bicycles among the questions for the talk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will confirm the person's wishes and retain only general school-travel and bicycle questions on the list. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 質問を出す方の希望もお確かめください。勝手に別の意味に直さないようにお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check the wishes of the people submitting questions. Do not change their meaning on your own.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 短くまとめる時も、元の質問と同じ意味か本人へ聞きます。質問を出さない選択も伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 要約意味を本人確認し提出しない選択も伝えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Even when shortening a question, I will ask the person whether it still means the same as the original. I will also tell them they can choose not to submit it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the meaning of summaries with their authors and tell them they may choose not to submit a question. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 講話で扱える範囲や時間は、担当に相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please discuss the scope and time available for the talk with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 承知しました。質問一覧を整理してから担当へ送り、個別の事故については別に相談する方法を案内してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 整理一覧を担当送付し個別相談は別方法を聞くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will organize the question list before sending it to the person in charge and ask for guidance on a separate way to consult about individual accidents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will send the organized list to the person in charge and ask about a separate method for individual consultations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当への連絡方法をご案内します。準備にご協力いただきありがとうございます。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will explain how to contact the person in charge. Thank you for helping with the preparations. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 発送した後の控えについて、ご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the receipt you receive after shipping?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。相手にも送った証拠を見せたいので、控えを荷物の中へ入れたいと思いました。今から入れられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 将来発送控えを荷物中へ同封したく可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I wanted to put the receipt inside the package so the recipient could also see proof that I sent it. Can I put it in now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can enclose the future shipping receipt inside the package. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 発送の手続きでお渡しする控えは、差し出した方が確認に使うものです。荷物の準備とは順番も異なります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The receipt issued during the shipping procedure is for the sender to check the shipment. The order of steps is also different from preparing the package.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうですね。まだ手続き前なので控えはありません。送った後に、自分から知らせる方法を考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 手続前で控え未発行を理解し発送後に別連絡を考える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: That is right. I have not completed the procedure yet, so there is no receipt. I will think of a way to notify the recipient myself after sending it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that you understand no receipt has been issued before the procedure, and consider contacting the recipient separately after shipping. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 利用する方法に応じて、確認できる情報をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will explain what information you can check according to the service you use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。中へ入れる手紙には今日の日付を書きますが、それを発送した証拠と同じにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同封手紙の日付と実発送証拠を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I will put today's date on the enclosed letter, but I will not treat that as the same as proof of actual shipment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the date on the enclosed letter from proof of actual shipping. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 控えを受け取ったら、内容をご自身でもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once you receive the receipt, please check its contents yourself as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。必要な情報を相手へ知らせ、元の控えは自分で残します。全部の写真を無条件で送るのではなく、表示も見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 控え内容を確認し必要情報のみ共有して原控えを残すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will give the recipient the necessary information and keep the original receipt myself. I will check what is displayed instead of sending a photo of everything unconditionally.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the receipt, share only necessary information, and keep the original. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お問い合わせに必要な情報も、控えでお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check the receipt for the information needed for inquiries.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。荷物は先に準備し、手続き後の控えは保管します。相手への連絡は発送の後にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 荷物準備後発送し控え保管と受取人連絡を後で行うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will prepare the package first and keep the receipt after the procedure. I will contact the recipient after shipping.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will prepare and send the package, then keep the receipt and contact the recipient afterward. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、お荷物の受付をご案内します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will explain how to hand in your package. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 家計の記録について、何をご確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to check about your household expense records?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 海外で使った金額を、円の家計メモへそのまま写しました。銀行の記録も間違えたことになるのか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 外貨支出を円家計メモへ数字流用し銀行記録も誤りか心配を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I copied the amounts I spent overseas directly into my household notes in yen. I am worried that this means the bank's records are wrong too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your concern that copying foreign-currency spending figures into yen household notes may also mean the bank records are wrong. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身のメモと、銀行の取引記録は別です。どの記録を見て写しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Your own notes and the bank's transaction records are separate. Which record did you copy from?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 旅行のレシートです。通貨の名前を省いたので、全部円で払ったようになってしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旅行領収の通貨名省略が誤記原因と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: My travel receipts. I left out the currency names, so it looks as if I paid for everything in yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that omitting the currency names from travel receipts caused the recording error. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず元の資料の金額と通貨をご確認ください。口座の取引についても、ご質問はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: First, check the amounts and currencies in the original documents. Do you have questions about the account transactions too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: あります。引き落とされた円の金額は、この通帳の行で確認したいです。レシートの数字と同じになると決めずに見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 円引落通帳行を元外貨額と同一とせず確認希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I would like to check the amount debited in yen on this line in my bankbook. I will check without assuming it must match the figure on the receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check the bankbook line for the yen debit without treating it as identical to the original foreign-currency amount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 取引の表示について、ご本人確認後にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will explain the transaction display after confirming your identity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。家計メモを直すための質問で、銀行の記録の数字を変えてほしいという意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家計訂正相談で銀行記録変更依頼ではないと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I am asking so I can correct my household notes; I do not mean that I want you to change the figures in the bank's records.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Clarify that this is a consultation about correcting household notes, not a request to alter bank records. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご相談として伺います。ご自身の資料も区別してお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will handle it as that kind of inquiry. Please also bring your own documents separately identified.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。外国通貨のレシートと円の口座記録を分けて確認し、家計メモには通貨も書き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 外貨領収と円記録を別確認し家計通貨名も修正すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will check the foreign-currency receipts separately from the yen account records and correct the currency names in my household notes too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check foreign-currency receipts and yen records separately and correct the currency names in your household notes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、口座の記録を確認します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check your account records. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お探しの商品は見つかりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did you find the product you were looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友達に頼まれた物がありません。似た袋の物を買おうかと思いましたが、中身が違うかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人依頼品がなく類似袋の代替を迷うと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I cannot find what my friend asked me to buy. I thought of buying something in a similar bag, but the contents might be different.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the item your friend requested is unavailable and you are unsure about a substitute in a similar bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 頼まれた商品の名前が分かるものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have anything that shows the name of the requested product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この写真です。袋の色は似ていますが、写真の方は砂糖なしと書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 元写真を示し無糖表記と類似色を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: This photo. The bag colors are similar, but the one in the photo says no sugar.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the original photo and explain the no-sugar label and similar color. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの商品は、表示を見比べてご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please compare the labels to check this product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。色だけで同じと思わず、砂糖が入っているかを先に読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 包装色で同一視せず糖表示を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will first read whether it contains sugar instead of assuming they are the same because of the color.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the sugar label without assuming identical packaging colors mean identical products. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 代わりの商品を買うかは、頼まれた方ともご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also discuss with the person who asked you whether to buy a substitute.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そうします。友達に、元の物が見つからず、この候補は表示が違うと連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 候補相違と欠品を依頼者へ連絡して判断を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will. I will tell my friend I cannot find the original item and this possible substitute has a different label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Contact the requester about the unavailable item and differences in the substitute, and ask them to decide. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要なら、ほかの候補の売り場もご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: If needed, I can also show you where other possible substitutes are stocked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。返事が来るまでは買わず、見つからなければ今回は買わない選択も友達へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未返信は購入せず非購入案も本人へ伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will not buy anything until I receive a reply. I will also tell my friend that not buying anything this time is an option if I cannot find it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not buy without a reply and will tell the person that buying nothing is also an option. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、ご確認ください。お買い物をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please check with them. Enjoy your shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 貸し出した物について、何かお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about something you borrowed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このボールを借りました。子どもが自分のボールと間違えそうなので、名前のシールを貼ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同色自己球と混同回避のため借用球へ名前貼付可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I borrowed this ball. My child might mistake it for our own ball, so may I put a name sticker on it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask permission to label a borrowed ball with your name to avoid confusing it with your own ball of the same color. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 貸出品へシールを貼る前に、ご相談ください。ご自身の物は別にお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please consult us before putting stickers on borrowed items. Do you also have your own with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。同じ色のボールがあります。借りた方に名前を書くと、私の物のようになってしまいますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自己球も所持し借用球記名で所有誤解になると認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. We have a ball of the same color. Writing my name on the borrowed one would make it look as though it belongs to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that you have your own ball and naming the borrowed ball could cause confusion about ownership. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの管理用の表示で区別してください。ご自身の物は別に置いてお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please distinguish it by our management label. Keep your own item separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。子どもに、この表示のある方は公園へ返す物だと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 管理表示で借用を見分け子供へ返却対象を伝えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will tell my child that the one with this label must be returned to the park.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will identify the borrowed ball by its management label and tell your child which one must be returned. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 貸出品の表示は、はがしたり隠したりしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do not peel off or cover the labels on borrowed items.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。名前のシールは貼らず、管理の表示をそのままにします。使う時も二つを見比べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 氏名貼付なしで管理表示を保持し使用時二球照合すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will not put a name sticker on it and will leave the management label as it is. I will compare the two when we use them too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not add a name label, will preserve the management label, and will compare both balls during use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 返却する時にも、借りた物をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: When returning it, please check that it is the item you borrowed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうします。返す前に管理の表示を見て、私のボールを間違えて渡さないようにします。借りた物は加工しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返却前管理表示を見て自己球誤返却を防ぎ無加工を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. Before returning it, I will look at the management label so I do not hand over my own ball by mistake. I will not alter the borrowed item.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the management label before return, avoid mistakenly returning your own ball, and make no alterations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、返却のご案内に沿ってお使いください。お楽しみください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please follow the return instructions when using it. Have fun. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 行き先の駅名で、お困りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the name of your destination station?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友達が電話で速く言ったので、駅名の最後が聞き取れませんでした。途中までの音だけ覚えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 速い電話で駅名末尾不明で途中音しか覚えていないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My friend said it quickly on the phone, so I could not catch the end of the station name. I only remember part of how it sounded.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the fast phone conversation left the end of the station name unclear and you remember only part of its sound. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 文字で確認できるメッセージなどはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have a message or something where you can check it in writing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだありません。似た名前を見つけたので、その駅へ行こうと思いかけました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 文字未受領で似た駅へ行くと決めかけたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I found a similar name and almost decided to go to that station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not received it in writing and almost chose a similarly named station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 似た音だけで決めず、お友達に駅名を文字で送ってもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Instead of deciding based only on a similar sound, could you ask your friend to send the station name in writing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、頼みます。駅の名前と市の名前が同じとは限らないので、駅名として送ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人へ都市名でなく駅名文字を要求すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I will. The station name and the city name are not necessarily the same, so I will ask for the station name specifically.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask your friend for the written station name rather than the city name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 届いた表記で行き先をご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once it arrives, please ask us about your destination using that spelling.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今届きました。この漢字です。私の聞いた音と違う所があるので、読み方も教えてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 届いた漢字表記と聞取音の相違から読方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: It has just arrived. These are the characters. Some parts differ from what I heard, so I would also like to know how to pronounce it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how to read the station name because the received written characters differ from the sounds you heard. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 表記を確認して、読み方と列車の案内をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the spelling and explain the pronunciation and train information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。行き先が決まってから切符を買います。友達にも、文字で確かめた駅名を返して確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確定後購入し文字駅名を友人へ返して確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will buy a ticket after confirming the destination. I will also send my friend the station name I checked in writing to confirm it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will buy after the destination is confirmed and send the written station name back to your friend for confirmation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、駅名から確認しましょう。お気をつけてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let us start by checking the station name. Have a safe trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 講座のお申し込みについて、もう一度説明しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like me to explain the course application again?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お願いします。家で申込書を書いた後、先に電話するのか、窓口へ出すのか分からなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 講座申込前の電話と窓口提出の順番を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Please. After filling out the form at home, I became unsure whether to call first or submit it at the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the order of calling and submitting the course application at the counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この講座は、申込書をこちらの窓口へ提出してください。提出前のお電話は不要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: For this course, please submit the application at this counter. You do not need to call before submitting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、家で書いてから持ってきます。受付の後は、私からまた電話するのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 窓口提出方針を伝え受付後の自己電話要否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I will fill it out at home and bring it here. After you accept it, should I call again myself?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State your plan to submit it at the counter and ask whether you need to call afterward. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 申込書の連絡先へ担当から連絡します。こちらの控えも保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will contact you using the details on the form. Please keep this receipt too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。提出して、控えを受け取り、連絡を待つという順番をメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 提出控え受領連絡待ちの順をメモすると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will note down the order: submit the form, receive the receipt, then wait to be contacted.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will note the sequence of submission, receipt collection, and waiting for contact. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。連絡先は、日中につながる番号をお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. For your contact number, please enter a number where you can be reached during the day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 仕事中は電話に出られないので、連絡できる時間も用紙に書いてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 仕事中不応答のため希望連絡時刻の記入可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I cannot answer calls while working. May I also write on the form what time I can be contacted?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can write your preferred contact time because you cannot answer during work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 余白へご希望の時間を書いてください。担当へお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please write your preferred time in the blank space. I will pass it on to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。午後六時以降と書きます。家でもこのメモを見ながら申込書を用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 六時以降希望を記入し家で申込準備すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will write after six in the evening. I will use these notes to prepare the application at home too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will write your preference for after six and prepare the application at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご用意できましたら窓口へお持ちください。それでは、お待ちしております。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: When it is ready, please bring it to the counter. We look forward to seeing you. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご本人からも、付け加えたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you would like to add yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。家族が「少し痛い」と言いましたが、私はそれより強く感じています。自分からも説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族の少し痛いという説明より強く感じ自己補足したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My family said it hurts a little, but I feel the pain more strongly than that. I would like to explain it myself too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the pain feels stronger than your family's description of slight pain and you want to add your own explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身が感じることを、診療担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell the medical staff what you feel yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。家族を責めたいのではありません。私が母語で言ったことが、短く訳されて伝わったようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 非難でなく母語発話が短く翻訳された経緯を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. I am not trying to blame my family. It seems what I said in my native language was translated in a shortened form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you are not blaming anyone and that your native-language statement seems to have been translated briefly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 言葉の支援が必要か、担当に相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can discuss whether language assistance is needed with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。痛みの強さと、いつから気になるかを、自分が分かる言葉で伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の語で強さと時期を伝える支援を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I want to describe how strong the pain is and when it started bothering me in words I understand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request help to convey the intensity and timing in your own words. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今の状態について、すぐに確認してほしいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is there anything about your current condition that you want checked immediately?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今も痛みがあります。大丈夫とまとめず、そのまま担当へ伝えてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現在痛も残存し大丈夫と要約せず担当へ伝えてほしいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am still in pain now. Please tell the person in charge exactly that instead of summarizing it as being all right.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the pain persists now and ask that it be conveyed to the person in charge without summarizing it as being all right. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現在のご様子を担当に知らせます。家族の方も、ご本人の説明をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will tell the person in charge about your current condition. Family members, please also wait for the patient's own explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。自分で話せない言葉は支援を頼み、説明の後に私の意味と合っているか確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不明語は支援依頼し訳の意味と自己意図を確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will ask for help with words I cannot express myself, and after the explanation I will check that it matches what I mean.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will request help with unfamiliar words and check that the translation matches your intended meaning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、担当に現在の状態とご希望を伝えます。こちらでお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21214-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will tell the person in charge about your current condition and wishes. Please wait here. Goodbye.
